profile.headline: AI Engineer | Senior Software Engineer · GenAI · RAG Pipelines · LLM Integration · Claude · LangChain · AWS · Java/Spring Boot · Python
profile.summary:
I'm an AI Engineer and Senior Software Engineer with 12+ years of experience building scalable, cloud-native backend systems across banking, logistics, and financial industries — now fully focused on applying Generative AI to solve real enterprise problems.

🤖 On the AI side, I design and build:
• RAG pipelines (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) using Claude, LangChain, and Pinecone
• LLM-powered knowledge management systems and intelligent assistants
• Prompt engineering frameworks and AI-augmented developer workflows
• Deep learning models with PyTorch and TensorFlow

⚙️ On the engineering side, I bring a strong foundation in:
• Java / Spring Boot microservices on AWS, PCF, and OpenShift
• CI/CD automation with Jenkins, Docker, and Kubernetes
• API design, event-driven systems (Kafka), and legacy modernization
• Banking and fintech systems (TD Bank, Discover, BMO Harris, BCI)

I believe the best AI products are built on solid engineering foundations. My goal is to bridge both worlds — shipping intelligent, production-ready systems that scale.

📍 Based in Chicago | Open to AI/ML Engineering roles (on-site, hybrid, or remote)
🔗 github.com/mtapia79

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built a full-stack RAG chatbot using Claude (Anthropic SDK), Pinecone, and Flask with streaming responses and real-time source attribution.

- Developed an LLM-powered knowledge base system inspired by Karpathy's architecture — automating wiki generation from raw notes with Obsidian, prompt templates, and data visualizations.

- Engineered Spring Boot microservices for TD Bank's DF3 data migration platform (Apache Spark + Autosys), handling large-scale transactional workloads.

- Led backend development for FedEx Dock Management Tool — REST APIs, Angular UI on AWS, and Jenkins CI/CD pipelines.

- Modernized BNSF Railway's reporting platform for OpenShift migration, improving data throughput by 35%.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Integrated LLM APIs for automated code documentation and developer onboarding, reducing ramp-up time for new team members.
Modernized core ops tools: Silverlight → Angular 8 + Spring Boot backend.
Automated CI/CD on IBM Bluemix — cut deployment time by 40%.

positions.title: IT Consultant
positions.description:
Migrated legacy WebSphere SOA apps to Spring Boot microservices on PCF — reduced release time by 70%.
Implemented Jenkins + Docker CI/CD; integrated Splunk for production observability.

positions.title: Sr. Sofware Engineer
positions.description:
Led CI/CD enablement as part of BCI's bank-wide Digital Transformation initiative — a cross-functional program spanning new strategies, evolving job roles, and closer collaboration across business units.

Served as a transversal technical resource across Agile teams (Development, QA, and Production), providing hands-on support for Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment pipelines across multiple software solutions.

positions.title: Application Architect
positions.description:
Application Architect at IBM Chile — my first exposure to AI in enterprise settings — serving clients across Banking, Oil & Gas, Retail, Aviation, Mining, and Healthcare.

• Designed and delivered end-to-end solution architectures across the full SDLC: from requirements and component modeling to production deployment.
• Built cognitive chatbots using IBM Watson and Node.js, sparking a long-term interest in applied AI and intelligent automation.
• Applied IBM architecture standards across process improvement, audits, and technical consulting for major enterprise clients.
• Led Agile cross-functional teams, ensuring alignment between business goals, security requirements, and technical delivery.
